text:
Every night, this game showed me one more boat than there was.

Eight fishing boats on a black lake, each with a small yellow lamp at the bow. I counted them on every sweep of the light, the way the game tells you to. One, two, three, all the way to eight. And then, low on the water, just past the last one, a ninth lamp. No hull under it. No mast. No wake. Just a lamp, sitting on the water like someone was holding it up from below.

The counter in the corner of the screen said eight.

Let me go back to the beginning.
